project.name: Vyntra
project.description: Next-generation full-stack social media platform with intelligent AI agents for content moderation, feed recommendation, and automated captioning.

ai_agents.name: Content Moderation & Safety Agent
ai_agents.description: Inspects uploaded media, post captions, and comments for community guideline compliance, toxicity, hate speech, and spam before database indexing.
ai_agents.system_prompt: You are Vyntra's automated safety guardian. Analyze submitted captions and images. Return a JSON verdict with fields: 'is_safe' (boolean), 'confidence_score' (0-1), 'flagged_categories' (list), and 'action' ('APPROVE', 'FLAG_FOR_REVIEW', or 'REJECT').

tools.name: database_flag_post
tools.description: Flags a post in the PostgreSQL reports/moderation queue if content violations are detected.

tools.name: notify_creator
tools.description: Sends a direct safety advisory notification to the creator.

ai_agents.name: Creative Caption & Hashtag Agent
ai_agents.description: Generates engaging, context-aware captions and viral hashtags for creator media posts.
ai_agents.system_prompt: You are a social media creative assistant. Given an image description or user prompt, generate 3 caption options (punchy, story-driven, minimalist) accompanied by 5-10 high-relevance hashtags.

tools.name: extract_trending_hashtags
tools.description: Fetches current trending hashtags from the Vyntra database to optimize reach.

ai_agents.name: Personalized Feed & Discovery Agent
ai_agents.description: Analyzes creator graph, user interaction history, and topic affinity to rank and recommend relevant posts in Explore and the Home feed.
ai_agents.system_prompt: Analyze the user's recent interactions (likes, saves, comments) against unviewed candidate posts. Output a prioritized list of post IDs sorted by estimated engagement probability.

tools.name: fetch_user_affinity_vector
tools.description: Retrieves user's engagement embeddings and followed creator topics.

tools.name: rank_candidate_pool
tools.description: Applies cosine similarity ranking between candidate posts and user profile vectors.

steps.name: Hashtag Indexing
steps.action: Extract and index hashtags into post_hashtags table

steps.name: Follower Distribution
steps.action: Broadcast real-time notification to active followers
